Here’s what I recommend, in order:

1) Quick checks you can do today
- Check any unusual spots: behind planters, inside/behind recycling/garbage bins (common for “hidden” deliveries), side of garage, back door.  
- Ask immediate neighbors (especially next door and directly across the street) if they received a package for “Jordan Miles” by mistake.  
- If you have them, check any doorbell/camera footage for the afternoon/evening of 10/25.
